name: Game Development
description: Designing and building games: engines, gameplay systems, physics, AI, rendering, audio and shipping.

nodes.name: Game design
nodes.desc: Core loops, mechanics, goals, feedback and what makes play engaging.

nodes.name: The game loop
nodes.desc: Update and render loops, fixed versus variable time steps and frame timing.

nodes.name: Game maths
nodes.desc: Vectors, interpolation, angles and transforms used in gameplay code.

nodes.name: Using an engine
nodes.desc: Scenes, game objects, components and scripting in an engine such as Godot or Unity.

nodes.name: Entities & components
nodes.desc: Composition over inheritance and the entity-component-system pattern.

nodes.name: Scene graphs
nodes.desc: Parent-child transforms and organising a game world.

nodes.name: Input handling
nodes.desc: Keyboard, mouse, controller and touch input with action mapping.

nodes.name: Performance budgets
nodes.desc: Frame budgets, memory allocation and cache-friendly data layouts.

nodes.name: Arcade clone
nodes.desc: Build a complete small arcade game like Breakout with scoring and levels.

nodes.name: Collision detection
nodes.desc: Bounding volumes, separating axis tests and broad-phase culling.

nodes.name: Rigid-body physics
nodes.desc: Integration, forces, impulses and resolving collisions.

nodes.name: Game AI
nodes.desc: Finite state machines, behaviour trees and steering behaviours.

nodes.name: Pathfinding
nodes.desc: A* on grids and navigation meshes.

nodes.name: Menus, HUD & saves
nodes.desc: Game UI, state management between screens and save files.

nodes.name: Rendering for games
nodes.desc: Sprites, batching, cameras, level of detail and lighting in engines.

nodes.name: Shaders & VFX
nodes.desc: Particle systems and shader effects.

nodes.name: Character animation
nodes.desc: Sprite and skeletal animation, blending and animation state machines.

nodes.name: Game audio
nodes.desc: Sound effects, music, mixing and spatial audio.

nodes.name: Platformer
nodes.desc: Build a platformer with physics, enemies, animation, menus and saves.

nodes.name: Multiplayer netcode
nodes.desc: Client-server models, prediction, interpolation and lag compensation.

nodes.name: Profiling games
nodes.desc: Finding CPU and GPU bottlenecks with profilers.

nodes.name: Playtesting & tuning
nodes.desc: Running playtests and balancing difficulty from feedback and data.

nodes.name: Shipping a game
nodes.desc: Builds for multiple platforms, store pages and post-launch updates.

nodes.name: Game capstone
nodes.desc: Design, build, test and publish an original game.
